metadata.description: 6 plugins, all six bundles: solo-skills (every skill that stands on its own - harness and environment config, session discipline, research, diagrams, repo setup, planning, comms, and Obsidian plugin development - in one install), code-desk (next-release execution plus planning, comms, board triage, repo scaffolding, and deck themes), diagrams (structural diagrams), atelier (tiered delegation agents and session-discipline hooks), obsidian-toolkit (Obsidian plugin-dev guidance), and plugin-feedback (hooks that invite defect reports on the plugins in use). The one-skill plugins were retired into solo-skills: a plugin is the unit of installation, so per-skill installs are no longer offered.

plugins.description: Bring a software project through the next-release execution loop, a documented repo standard, and the executive-desk overhead together — plan the work into conformant issues and source-grounded plans, keep the repo's meta-structure/memory/README to standard, produce recurring status comms, run board triage, and build themed PowerPoint decks.
plugins.name: code-desk

plugins.description: Structural diagrams for repo docs, decks, and architecture briefings - Mermaid for GitHub-rendered markdown (house rule: no parentheses or special characters in node labels), Python diagrams for cloud architecture with provider icons (Azure first, GCP legacy), draw.io legacy-file reading and headless export, Excalidraw sketch diagrams with an author-the-JSON fallback when MCP tools are absent, and raw Graphviz - all feeding SVG+PNG output pipelines with light/dark-friendly styling. Structural diagrams only: data charts belong to the dataviz skill, deck theming to pptx-themes.
plugins.name: diagrams

plugins.description: Run delegated work across three layers — strategy, management, execution: size the task, pick a delegation architecture, and dispatch scoped slices to model-tiered agents (scout, builder, reviewer, manager). Skills cover orchestration, session handoff, backlog waves, and a review cycle (rubric-panel, deletion-pass, layer-cycle). Hooks watch context watermarks, guard handoff freshness, surface the handoff on cold start, log delegation tier usage, nudge on retained-labor streaks, brief workers on the delegation covenant, and hold protected config in custody per project.
plugins.name: atelier

plugins.description: Obsidian guidance bundle - plugin API fundamentals (lifecycle, settings, vault operations, commands), chat/copilot sidebar UI patterns, in-plugin MCP servers over Streamable HTTP, and vault automation via the official Obsidian CLI, packaged as a separately toggleable plugin.
plugins.name: obsidian-toolkit

plugins.description: Report a defect in a plugin you are using without leaving the session. A session-start hook tells the primary session it may file a bug or a feature request; a subagent-start hook gives dispatched workers the tier rule (file a bug directly when observed behavior contradicts the plugin's own stated contract, but draft a feature request for your dispatcher rather than filing it); and a stdlib reporter writes the issue to a fixed template (plugin and version, consuming project, date, symptom and repro, severity and the contract check, workaround, optional fix) instead of a free-handed gh invocation. Install it alongside whatever else you run from this marketplace.
plugins.name: plugin-feedback

plugins.description: Every skill in this collection that stands on its own - one install instead of a shelf of one-skill plugins. Membership is derived, not curated: a skill belongs here when it needs no agent, no hook, and no sibling skill to do its job, and a gate re-derives that from the skill bodies and their bundled scripts on every run. Covers harness and environment configuration (Claude Code, opencode, project memory, iTerm2), session discipline (handoff, focus checks, review cycles), research and decision support, diagrams and data visualization, repo and project setup, planning and recurring comms, and Obsidian plugin development. The skills that need a companion agent or hook stay in the bundles that carry them.
plugins.name: solo-skills
